title: SETx-1km-CMIP6: A 1 km dual-kriging downscaled NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 dataset for Eastern Texas (code)
description: This contains code that downscales NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 model output to 1 km daily fields over East Texas with universal kriging (KrigR), and the codes that run quality control and evaluation on those fields. It covers eight variables: near-surface air temperature (tas), daily maximum and minimum temperature (tasmax, tasmin), near-surface wind speed (sfcWind), specific and relative humidity (huss, hurs), and downwelling longwave and shortwave radiation (rlds, rsds). The downscaling stage uses a gated pipeline that enforces a per-iteration coverage gate and deletes failing timesteps. Precipitation (pr) is out of scope.
